entry.title: Kazimierz Górski National Stadium
entry.note: Exact fixed-roof footprint replaces the577m leisure estate polygon. Roof PCA establishes the major axis, and architect plan supplies the symmetric northwest +Z pitch convention. The retained earth berm is reconstructed as a continuous sloped envelope from published sections; the separate mapped base contains ramp/service cut-ins and is preserved as reference, not copied as a jagged slope. Remote estate paving and service buildings remain ordinary map geometry. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
